title: 969. Interval List Intersections

examples.explanation: Each overlapping pair contributes its shared segment; touching endpoints count as length-zero intersections.
With one list empty there are no overlaps.

hints: Walk both sorted lists with two pointers, always advancing the interval that ends first.
Two intervals [a,b] and [c,d] overlap exactly when max(a,c) <= min(b,d); that pair of extremes is the intersection.
Each step emits at most one intersection, giving linear time.
